preconditions: Independent Primary4, prevention/safeguarding, inclusion and rubric review before classroom use. Agree local trusted-adult/safeguarding arrangements.

Campaign stays in the classroom with a teacher-approved supportive message and one willing peer. No public posting, personal disclosures, frightening images, real substances/medicine, diagnosis or treatment. No prevention outcome is inferred.
Tabletop uses only paper objects at a desk, introduced clearly as fiction. No realistic alarm/drill, staged threat, real stranger, surveillance, patrol, live call or actual reporting to an agency.
Provide appropriate access arrangements; assess the intended skill with an independently reviewed equivalent if needed. Do not score a written plan as observed or spoken performance.
evidenceRequirements: Observe each pupil’s own campaign artifact, delivery and interactive help-seeking contribution. Group attendance alone does not earn individual marks.
For013 follow tabletop-script.md, then hear the pupil’s own report. Record observed facts/uncertainty against criteria; do not pre-fill a claim of real-world observation.
